Transport Should Open Doors, Not Close Them
Finding work is difficult enough. Reaching work should not become the reason someone loses that opportunity.
Across Cape Town, many workers travel long distances, start early shifts and spend a large part of their income on transport.
At the same time, thousands of vehicles travel along the same routes with available seats.
Pool Up was created to bring these journeys together.
One person may need a ride. Several people travelling at the same time can create a reliable route.
How Pool Up Works
1. Register Your Work Route
Tell us your pickup area, workplace area, shift time and the days you need transport.
2. We Find a Suitable Match
We group commuters travelling in the same direction and match them with verified drivers or approved transport partners.
3. Add Ride Credit
Once your route and price are confirmed, you add prepaid credit to your Pool Up account.
4. Travel With Confidence
Your booking, driver details, meeting point and journey information are confirmed before the trip.

This includes workers travelling to factories, warehouses, offices, retail centres, hospitals, hotels, restaurants, security sites, industrial areas and other places of employment.
Our first version focuses mainly on trips to the workplace.
Return routes will be introduced where there is enough demand and suitable driver availability.

about-us: ABOUT US
A Transport Idea Born During a Difficult Time
Pool Up was established during the COVID-19 period.
The pandemic showed how quickly a transport problem could become an employment problem.
When people could not reach work, interviews, training or essential services, opportunities disappeared.
It also showed the strength of communities.
People shared information, food, transport and support because they understood that progress depends on people helping one another.
During this period, we saw vehicles travelling with open seats while workers along the same routes struggled with expensive or unreliable transport.
Pool Up was created to close that gap.
We are building a community work travel network where verified people travelling in the same direction can share the journey and share the cost.
Our Mission
To make daily work travel more affordable, reliable and accessible by connecting verified commuters, drivers and transport partners travelling along similar routes.
Our Vision
A South Africa where transport cost and distance do not decide who gets to work, keeps a job or reaches an opportunity.
Our Values
People First
Every route begins with a real person who needs to reach work safely and with dignity.
Opportunity Within Reach
Transport should connect people to employment, education, training and progress.
Open and Fair
Prices, service fees, driver contributions and booking conditions must be clearly explained.
Local Progress
We build routes around the needs of local workers, businesses and communities.
The POOL Values
P: People first O: Opportunity within reach O: Open and fair L: Local progress
Our Promise
We will grow carefully, one route at a time.
We will not promise a service before the route, driver and transport arrangements are ready.
Safety comes before growth.
Clear communication comes before marketing.
People come before numbers.
how-it-works: HOW IT WORKS
A Simple Way to Organise Shared Work Travel
Pool Up is not an instant taxi service.
We organise regular work routes by matching people travelling from similar areas, at similar times, to similar employment destinations.
For Commuters
Register
Provide your general pickup area, workplace area, shift starting time and required travel days.
You do not need to provide your complete home address during the first registration.
Get Matched
Our team reviews the registered demand and searches for a suitable verified driver or approved transport partner.
Review the Trip
You receive the proposed meeting point, departure time, price, driver information and route conditions.
Add Credit
Prepaid ride credit is added after your payment has been confirmed.
Confirm Your Seat
The required credit is allocated to the booking and your seat is confirmed.
Complete the Journey
After the trip, you can confirm completion, rate your experience or report a concern.
For Drivers
Apply
Tell us about yourself, your vehicle, your regular work route and your available seats.
Complete Verification
Your identity, driving licence, vehicle documents and relevant compliance information are reviewed.
Publish Your Route
Approved drivers provide their regular route, available days, departure time and number of available seats.
Accept Suitable Commuters
You receive information about the proposed passenger and meeting arrangement before accepting.
Complete the Journey
Follow the confirmed route, meeting point and community standards.
Receive Your Contribution
Your driver amount is recorded after the journey is completed, subject to the agreed payout process and service fee.
How Pool Up V1 Works
The first version of Pool Up is supported by our team through the website, online forms and WhatsApp.
Route matching, verification, credit confirmation and booking support may be completed manually while we learn which work corridors have the strongest demand.
The public website explains the service and collects registrations.
A future member app will make matching, booking, ride credit, trip records, ratings and support faster.
The technology will change. The purpose will remain the same.

faqs: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What Is Pool Up?
Pool Up is a work-route matching platform that connects verified commuters, drivers and approved transport partners travelling in the same direction.
Is Pool Up a Taxi Service?
Pool Up is designed around regular shared work routes rather than instant on-demand trips.
Certain routes may be provided by approved transport operators where required.
Who Can Use Pool Up?
The first version is intended for employed commuters, job seekers travelling to approved opportunities, verified drivers, employers and community partners.
Does Pool Up Operate Across Cape Town?
Routes are activated one corridor at a time.
Registering your route helps us decide where to launch next.
Does Registration Guarantee a Ride?
No.
A ride is only confirmed once there is a suitable verified driver or approved transport partner.
How Are Drivers Verified?
Drivers complete identity, licence, vehicle and relevant compliance checks before they can receive confirmed bookings.
Does Pool Up Own the Vehicles?
Not necessarily.
Pool Up works with verified private drivers and approved transport partners.
How Do Payments Work?
Passengers add prepaid ride credit.
Credit is used for confirmed journeys according to the pricing, cancellation and refund terms.
Can I Pay the Driver in Cash?
Passengers should not pay drivers directly unless Pool Up has provided written approval for a specific arrangement.
How Does Pool Up Make Money?
Pool Up earns a transparent service fee from completed bookings.
This supports verification, route coordination, payment administration, customer support and platform operations.
Can I Book a Return Journey?
The initial pilot prioritises journeys to the workplace.
Return routes will be added where demand and driver availability make them practical.
Can People With Disabilities Register?
Yes.
Accessibility requirements must be provided during registration.
A booking is confirmed only after a suitable vehicle and support arrangement have been identified.
What Happens When a Passenger Cancels?
The cancellation and refund policy depends on the time of cancellation, booking type and any costs already incurred.
How Can My Employer Join?
Employers can register staff travel demand, sponsor ride credit or request a shift-route pilot.
How Can a Foundation or Charity Participate?
Community organisations can sponsor ride credit, refer approved beneficiaries or work with Pool Up to create employment-access routes.
How Do I Report a Problem?
Use the safety reporting form, WhatsApp support or the official Pool Up contact details.
Immediate emergencies should be reported to emergency services first.
